name: pl_team_overview_bundle
description: Fetch team metadata for a specific team using the Pulselive metadata endpoint. (Note: core team data, form, and next fixture could not be reliably fetched via fetch() in this environment, so this routine focuses on the confirmed-metadata part of the bundle.)

operations.js: (() => { try { const text = document.body && document.body.innerText ? document.body.innerText : null; if (!text) { return { ok: false, error: 'No body text found' }; } const parsed = JSON.parse(text); return parsed; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: String(e) }; } })();

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Pulselive team ID (e.g., 1 for Manchester United).
